configError.title: The app is not configured
configError.hint: Copy .env.example to .env.local and fill in the values, or start against the emulators with npm run dev:emulator.

signIn.title: Sign in
signIn.description: Sign in with your Google account to see your calendars.

error.failed: Something went wrong while signing in. Please try again.
error.popupBlocked: The browser blocked the sign-in window. Allow pop-ups for this site and try again.

connect.title: Connect Google Calendar
connect.description: Spaces Calendar needs access to your Google calendars to show and change your events. Access is stored securely on the server, so you only need to do this once.

reconnect.title: Access to Google Calendar has ended
reconnect.description: Access was revoked or has expired. Reconnect to keep seeing and changing your events.

checkError.title: Could not check the connection to Google Calendar
checkError.description: Check your internet connection and try again.

error.popupBlocked: The browser blocked the Google window. Allow pop-ups for this site and try again.
error.loadFailed: Could not load Google's sign-in script. Check your internet connection and try again.
error.failed: Something went wrong at Google. Please try again.
error.insufficientScope: You need to approve access to your calendar. Try again and leave the Google Calendar box checked.
error.noRefreshToken: Google did not grant lasting access. Try again and approve all permissions.
error.codeExchangeFailed: Google's approval could not be used. Please try again.
error.unavailable: Could not reach Google or the server right now. Try again in a moment.
error.unknown: Something went wrong. Please try again.
